requirement: **No release before foundation critical path is complete.**
**No visual release before screenshot-contract path is complete.**
**No Agent release before true execution path is complete.**
**No Brain release before knowledge/provenance path is complete.**
**No owner-input release before provenance/conflict path is complete.**
**No integration release before provider adapter/security path is complete.**
**No automation release before permission/history path is complete.**
**No production cutover until all critical foundation gates pass together.**
**No acceptance based on isolated module demos.**
**A smaller correct subsystem beats a larger unstable one.**

**Every future feature must leave through a designed removal seam.**
**Every future feature must declare its blast radius before implementation.**
**Every future feature must prove it did not break unrelated behavior.**
